src: The last of the BRICS Ministerial meetings – the BRICS Ministers of Agriculture Meting – is currently underway, while the Ministerial Metings of Foreign Affairs, Security, Trade, Industry, Education, Science, Labour, Communications, Health, and Urbanisation Forum have concluded their reports for the Leaders’ Summit.
tgt: Umhlangano wokugcina woNgqongqoshe be-BRICS – uMhlangano Wezolimo woNgqongqoshe be-BRICS – uyaqhubeka, ngesikhathi iMihlangano yoNgqongqoshe Bezindaba Zangaphandle, Ezokuvikeleka, Ezohwebo, Izimboni, Ezemfundo, Isayensi, Ezabasebenzi, Ezokuxhumana, Ezempilo, kanye neForamu Yezokufudukela Emadolobheni isiyiphothulile imibiko yayo yeNgqungquthela Yabaholi.

src: The BRICS Outreach programmes for various sectors and communities have also been concluded.
tgt: Izinhlelo Zomphakathi ze-BRICS zemikhakha eyahlukahlukene nemiphakathi nazo seziphothuliwe.

src: These engagements provided governments, organisations, experts and academics from the BRICS nations an opportunity to discuss issues of mutual interest that will enable informed decision-making during the BRICS Summit.
tgt: Lezi zingxoxo zinike ohulumeni, izinhlangano, ochwepheshe nezifundiswa eziphuma emazweni ayingxenye ye-BRICS ithuba lokuxoxisana ngezindaba ezithinta la mazwe ezingaholela ekuthathweni kwezinqumo eziphusile ngesikhathi seNgqungquthela ye-BRICUBuyekezo Lweminyaka Eyishumi loHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kukazwelonke (i-NDP).

src: Cabinet welcomed the Ten-Year Review of the NDP by the National Planning Commission that pointed out that the economy remained structured in a manner that does not serve the interests of all South Africans, which is a major reason behind increasing levels of poverty and inequality.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele uBuyekezo Lweminyaka Eyishumi lwe-NDP olwenziwe iKhomishini Yezinhlelo Zikazwelonke olubonise ukuthi umnotho ubusalokhu wakheke ngendlela engahlangabezani nezidingo zabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika, okuyisona sizathu esikhulu esenza kunyuke amazinga obubha nokungalingani.

src: Government remains committed to restructuring and transforming the economy to serve the interests of all South Africans.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezinikele ekwakheni kabusha nasekuguquleni umnotho ukuze usebenzele izidingo zabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: The 25th July marked the First Anniversary since President Ramaphosa announced the Energy Action Plan.
tgt: Ezamandla Umhla wama-25 kuNtulikazi kuzobe kuphela uNyaka Wokuqala selokhu uMongameli u-Ramaphosa amemezela uHlelo Lokusebenza Lwezamandla.

src: Cabinet welcomed the progress made to date to implement the Energy Action Plan, which continues to register an improvement in the Energy Availability Factor and improvement in the stages of load-shedding.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele inqubekelaphambili eyenziwe kuze kube manje ekuqalisweni koHlelo Lokusebenza Lwezamandla, oluqhubekayo nokwenza kangcono ekuTholakaleni Kukagesi kanye nesimo esingcono ezigabeni zokucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Tourism Cabinet is pleased that the Tourism statistics for June 2023 show that our tourism sector is slowly but surely recovering from the devastating effects of the COVID-19 pandemic.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha IKhabhinethi likuthokozele ukuthi izibalo zeZokuvakasha zangoNhlangulana wezi-2023 zibonisa ukuthi umkhakha wethu wezokuvakasha kancane kancane uyavuka kwimithelela emibi yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19.

src: The June 2023 statistics from Statistics South Africa (Stats SA) show that the volume of arrivals, departures and travellers in transit increased for both South African residents and foreign travellers between June 2022 and June 2023.
tgt: Izibalo zangoNhlangulana wezi-2023 ezibuya kuMnyango Wezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA) zibonisa ukuthi umthamo wabafikayo, abaphumayo nabavakashi ukhuphukile kubahlali baseNingizimu Afrika nabavakashi abaphuma emazweni angaphandle phakathi kukaNhlangulana wezi-2022 noNhlangulana wezi-2023.

src: Economy Cabinet welcomed Stats SA’s report of a drop in consumer inflation from per cent in May to per cent in June 2023, which is the largest decline since May 2020.
tgt: Umnotho IKhabhinethi lamukele umbiko we-Stats SA wokwehla kwamandla emali kubathengi kusuka kumaphesenti ayisi-6.3 ngoNhlaba kwaya kumaphesenti ayisi-5.4 ngoNhlangulana wezi-2023, okungukwehla okukhulu kusuka ngoNhlaba wezi-2020.

src: This drop shows the resilience of our economy, which has been further buoyed by the South Africa Reserve Bank’s decision to leave the repo rate unchanged at 8.25 per cent.
tgt: Lokhu kwehla kubonisa ukuzimelela komnotho wethu, okuphinde kwamiswa isinqumo seBhangengodla laseNingizimu Afrika sokungaguquli isilinganiso sokubolekisa ngemali (i-repo rate) esilokhu simile kumaphesenti ayisi-.

src: South African Sign Language (SASL) Bill.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa woLwimi Lwezimpawu lwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SASL) IKhabhinethi lamukele ukusayinwa kwakamuva ukuthi ube ngumthetho uMthethosivivinywa we-SASL nguMongameli u-Ramaphosa, okwenze ukuthi i-SASL ibe ulwimi olusemthethweni lwe-12 eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Cabinet welcomed the recent signing into law of the SASL Bill by President Ramaphosa, which made the SASL the 12th official language in South Africa.
tgt: Lokhu kuzogqugquzela amalungelo abantu abasebenzisa i-SASL abalinganiselwa kwizi-600 000 eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Pre-release calendar for the publication of the quarterly crime statistics for the 2023/24 financial year Cabinet approved the pre-release calendar for the publication of the quarterly crime statistics for the 2023/24 financial year.
tgt: IZinqumo Zekhabhinethi Ukukhishwa kwekhalenda ukuze kuzoshicilelwa izibalo zobugebengu zekota zonyakamali wezi-2023/24 IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukukhishwa kwekhalenda ukuze kuzoshicilelwa izibalo zobugebengu zekota zonyakamali wezi-2023/24.

src: The crime statistics will be released in August and November 2023 for quarters one and two, and February and May 2024 for quarter three and quarter four respectively.
tgt: Izibalo zobugebengu zekota yokuqala neyesibili zizokhishwa ngoNcwaba nangoLwezi wezi-2023, bese kuthi ezekota yesithathu neyesine zikhishwe ngoNhlolanja nangoNhlaba wezi-2024 ngokulandelana.

src: The frequent release of crime statistics is important for monitoring crime trends and better decision-making in the fight against crime.
tgt: Ukuhlala njalo kukhishwa izibalo zobugebengu kubalulekile ekuqapheni ukwenzeka kobugebengu nasekuthatheni izinqumo kangcono ekulweni nobugebengu.

src: Financial Inclusion Policy Cabinet approved the Financial Inclusion Policy for implementation.
tgt: INqubomgomo Ebandakanyayo Yezezimali IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuqaliswa kweNqubomgomo Ebandakanyayo Yezezimali.

src: The policy forms part of government’s reforms of the financial sector regulations and in line with the Twin Peaks model of National Treasury.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo iyingxenye yezinguquko zikahulumeni zemithethonqubo yomkhakha wezezimali futhi ihambisana nendlela ye-Twin Peaks esetshenziswa nguMgcinimafa kaZwelonke.

src: The policy, amongst others, aims to ensure better market conduct and the treatment of customers in the financial sector.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo, phakathi kokunye, kuhloswe ngayo ukuqinisekisa ukusebenza kangcono kwezimakethe kanye nokuphathwa kahle kwabathengi emkhakheni wezezimali.

src: The purpose is to ensure that financial institutions conduct business in ways that are fair to customers, prevent practices that undermine the integrity of financial markets, and build confidence in the financial system.
tgt: Inhloso ngukuqinisekisa ukuthi izikhungo zezimali ziqhuba ibhizinisi ngendlela eneqiniso kubathengi, igweme izindlela zokusebenza ezibukela phansi izimakethe zezimali, kanye nokwakha ukuzethemba kwindlela yokusebenza kwezezimali.

src: The implementation of the policy will ensure that the country strengthens its financial systems to support economic growth and promote access to financial services and financial inclusion for all citizens.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwenqubomgomo kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi izwe liqinisa izindlela zokusebenza kwezezimali lokho okuzokweseka ukukhula komnotho futhi kugqugquzele ukufinyeleleka kwizinsizakalo zezimali kanye nokubandakanyeka kwezezimali kwazo zonke izakhamuzi.

src: It is an acknowledgment that while levels of access have improved in transactional accounts, this has not reflected across many other financial products and services.
tgt: Siyavuma ukuthi ngesikhathi izinga lokufinyelela kuma-akhawunti libe ngcono, lokhu akukabonakali kuyo yonke eminye imikhiqizo nezinsizakalo zezimali.

src: The policy is available on the National Treasury website: WEBTOKEN Bills.
tgt: Inqubomgomo iyatholakala kwisizindalwazi sikaMgcinimafa kaZwelonke esithi: WEBTOKEN IMithethosivivinywa.

src: National Prosecuting Authority (NPA) Amendment Bill of 2023.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela uPhiko Lukazwelonke Lwezokushushisa (i-NPA) wezi-2023.

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the draft NPA Amendment Bill of 2023 to Parliament.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela we-NPA wezi-2023 osahlongozwa.

src: The Bill amends the NPA Act, 1998 (Act 32 of 1998) to provide for the establishment of the Investigating Directorate as a permanent entity within the NPA and to also strengthen its investigative powers.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela umthetho we-NPA, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1998) ukuze uzohlinzeka ngokusungulwa koPhiko Lokuphenya Amacala njengengxenye ezohlale ikhona njalo ngaphakathi kwi-NPA kanye nokuqinisa amandla ayo okuphenya amacala.

src: The Regulation of Interception of Communications and Provision of Communication-related Information Amendment Bill.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ukulawulwa Kwezokuxhumana kanye Nokuhlinzekwa Kolwazi Oluhlobene Nezokuxhumana IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela osahlongozwa, ochibiyela uMthetho Olawula Ezokuxhumana kanye Nokuhlinzekwa Kolwazi Oluhlobene Nezokuxhumana (i-RICA), wezi-2002 (uMthetho wama-70 wezi-2002).

src: Cabinet approved the submission of the draft Amendment Bill to Parliament, which amends the Regulation of Communications and Provision of Communication-related Information Act (RICA), 2002 (Act 70 of 2002).
tgt: Izichibiyelo kuhloswe ngazo ukuvikela ilungelo lobumfihlo, njengoba kubalulwa ngamalungelo okufinyelela ezinkantolo, inkululeko yokubika yabezindaba kanye nelungelo elingokomthetho ngokuhambisana nesahlulelo sangowezi-2021 seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo eyathola ukuthi i-RICA yangowezi-2002 ayihambisani nomthethosisekelo.

src: AppointmentsAll appointments are subject to the verification of qualifications and relevant clearance.
tgt: Abaqashiwe Bonke abaqashiwe kufanele kuqinisekiswe iziqu zabo futhi bahlolisiswe ngokufanele.

src: Mr Percy Sechemane as Chief Executive Officer of the Trans -Caledon Tunnel Authority.
tgt: Percy Sechemane esikhundleni sokuba nguMphathi Omkhulu we-Trans -Caledon Tunnel Authority.

src: Ms Thathakahle Nonkqubela Jordan-Dyani as Director-General (DG) at the Department of Communications and Digital Technologies.
tgt: Thathakahle Nonkqubela Jordan-Dyani esikhundleni sokuba nguMqondisi-Jikelele (u-DG) kuMnyango Wezokuxhumana Nobuchwepheshe Bedijithali.

src: Mr Duncan Pieterse as DG at National Treasury.
tgt: Duncan Pieterse esikhundleni sokuba ngu-DG KuMgcinimafa Kazwelonke.

src: Ms Qinisile Precious Delwa as Deputy DG (DDG): Enterprise Development and Entrepreneurship at the Department of Small Business Development (DSBD).
tgt: Qinisile Precious Delwa esikhundleni sokuba yiPhini lika-DG (u-DDG): Ezokuthuthukiswa Nokusungulwa Kwamabhizinisi kuMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane (i-DSBD).

src: Ms Mosa Keneilwe Makhele as DDG: Sector Policy and Research at the DSBMr Xolisa Mabhongo as DDG: Global Governance and Continental Agenda at the Department of International Relations and Cooperation.
tgt: Mosa Keneilwe Makhele esikhundleni sokuba ngu-DDG: kwi-Sector Policy and Research e-DSBMnu.

src: Ms Rosinah Nghaka Dumalisile as DDG: Affordable Rental and Social Housing at the Department of Human Settlements.
tgt: Xolisa Mabhongo esikhundleni sokuba yi-DDG: kwi-Global Governance and Continental Agenda kuMnyango Wezindaba Zamazwe Ngamazwe Nokusebenzisana.

src: Mr Thabo Kekana as DDG: Programmes and Projects at the DMRNational Radioactive Waste Disposal Institute Board of Directors:
tgt: Rosinah Nghaka Dumalisile esikhundleni sokuba yi-DDG: kwi-Affordable Rental and Social Housing kuMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu.

src: National Nuclear Regulator Board of Directors: Mr Protas Phili – Chairperson (reappointment) (ii) Ms Pinkie Deneo Peta (reappointment) (iii) Mr Paul Heeger(iv) Ms Nolubabalo Zolisa Zwakala Dr Pathmanathan Naidoo(vi) Dr Nandi Malumbazo(vii) Ms Theodorah Bahlekazi and(viii) Mr Happy Khambule.
tgt: Lemao Dorah Modise (uSihlalo) Dkt.

src: Inkomati-Usuthu Catchment Management Agency Board of Directors: Ms Linda Carol Zulu (Chairperson)(ii) AdvGeraldine Khoza (Deputy Chairperson)(iii) Ms Shivon Wiggins(iv) Mr Sam Mthembu Mr Mokgobi Andrew Ramushu(vi) Mr Steven Matome Mathetsa and(vii) Ms Salome Chiloane-Nwabueze.
tgt: Wolsey Barnard (iPhini likaSihlalo) Nks.

src: State Information Technology Agency Board of Directors:
tgt: IBhodi labaQondisi le-National Nuclear Regulator: Mnu.

src: Mr Kiruben Pillay (Chairperson)(ii) Ms Lerato Petlele (Deputy Chairperson)(iii) Ms Khathu Sibanda(iv) Dr Lucienne Abraham(vi) Mr Luvuyo Keyise(vii) Mr Mandla Martin Mnisi (viii) Ms Renisha Naidoo(ix) Ms Nolitha Pietersen and Ms Laura Mseme.
tgt: Protas Phili – uSihlalo (uphinde wabekwa) (ii) Nks.

src: BRICS XV Summit and the Johannesburg II Declaration South Africa hosted a successful BRICS XV Summit that adopted the historic Johannesburg II Declaration.
tgt: Ezisematheni INgqungquthela ye-15 ye-BRICS kanye neSimemezelo saseGoli seSibili INingizimu Afrika isingathe ngempumelelo iNgqungquthela ye-15 ye-BRICS neyamukele ingqophamlando yeSimemezelo SaseGoli seSibili.

src: Cabinet expressed its appreciation to Team South Africa ably led by our State President, His Excellency Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa who ensured the Summit was a great success at the level of both content and logistics.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lidlulise ukubonga kwiThimba laseNingizimu Afrika eliholwa kuMongameli woMbuso, uMhlonishwa u-Cyril Matamela Ramaphosa oqinisekise ukuthi iNgqungquthela iyimpumelelo enkulu ezingeni lezwekazi nasekuhlelweni komcimbi wonke.

src: The President will address the nation on the successful BRICS XV Summit and other important matters.
tgt: UMongameli uzokhuluma nesizwe ngempumelelo yeNgqungquthela ye-15 ye-BRICS kanye nezinye izindaba ezibalulekile.

src: State Visit by Chinese President South Africa hosted a State Visit of His Excellency, President Xi Jinping of the People’s Republic of China on Tuesday, 22 August 2023, ahead of the BRICS Summit.
tgt: Uhambo Lomsebenzi lukaMongameli wase-China INingizimu Afrika isingathe uMhlonishwa, uMongameli u-Xi Jinping wase-China ngoLwesibili, mhla wama-22 kuNcwaba 2023, ngaphambi kokuqala kweNgqungquthela ye-BRICLolu Hambo Lomsebenzi luphinde lube luphawu lokubungaza iminyaka engama-25 yobudlelwano bamazwe phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-China.

src: The People’s Republic of China is currently South Africa’s largest trading partner.
tgt: Izwe lase-China njengamanje liyizwe elikhulu elihwebelana neNingizimu Afrika.

src: The People’s Republic of China had previously donated emergency power equipment worth R167 million and have since made available a grant of R500 million for development assistance.
tgt: Izwe lase-China ngokwedlule lanikela ngomshini ophehla ugesi wezimo eziphuthumayo wenani eliyizigidi eziyi-R167 laphinde lakhipha isibonelelo sezigidi ezingama-R500 zokusiza kwezentuthuko.

src: Cabinet welcomed the signing of various Agreements and Meoranda of Understanding between the South African government and the People’s Republic of China in the areas of trade, energy, higher education.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukusayinwa kweZivumelwano ezahlukahlukene phakathi kukahulumeni waseNingizimu Afrika nezwe lase-China emikhakheni yezohwebo, owezamandla nemfundo ephakeme.

src: Amongst the signed Agreements, it is the China-Africa Development Fund between the IDC and the Bank of China.
tgt: Phakathi kweZivumelwano ezisayiniwe, kube ukusayinwa kwesivumelwano seSikhwama sezeNtuthuko se-China ne-Afrika phakathi kwe-IDC kanye neBhange lase-China.

src: This Fund will stimulate increased investments in South Africa.
tgt: Lesi Sikhwama sizovuselela utshalomali eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Cabinet also welcomed the reopening of the Chinese market for the export of South African beef, in addition to the export of South African avocados to China.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela ukuvulwa futhi kwezimakethe saze-China ukuze kuzothunyelwa inyama yenkomo evela eNingizimu Afrika, ukwengeza kukwatapheya waseNingizimu Afrika othunyelwa e-China.

src: These export opportunities will unlock new opportunities for our local producers including small scale farmers.
tgt: La mathuba okuthunyelwa kwemikhiqizo yalapha ekhaya kwamanye amazwe azovula amathuba amasha kubakhiqizi bakuleli lizwe kubandakanya nabalimi kanye nabafuyi abasafufusa.

src: South Africa is negotiating with BYD, the Chinese automaker and the world’s largest electric vehicle manufacturer for possible opening of a manufacturing plant in South Africa.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isezingxoxweni ne-BYD, okuyinkampani yezimoto yase-China kanye nabakhiqizi abakhulukazi bezimoto ezihamba ngogesi ngethuba lokuvula isikhungo sokukhiqiza lapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: This is in addition to the opening of the BAIC manufacturing plant (another Chinese automaker) in South Africa.
tgt: Lokhu kwengeza ngaphezu kwethuba lesikhungo sokukhiqiza sakwa-BAIC (okungenye yezinkampani zemoto yase-China) eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Highlights of the Economy.
tgt: Amazwibela Ezomnotho.

src: Quarterly Labour Force Survey Cabinet welcomed the Quarterly Labour Force Survey results for quarter 2 as released by Statistics South Africa, which indicated a slight decrease in unemployment rate from 32.9% in the first quarter to 32.6% in the second quarter.
tgt: Ucwaningo Lwangekota Lwezabasebenzi IKhabhinethi lamukele imiphumela yoCwaningo Lwangekota Lwezabasebenzi lwekota yesibili njengoba ikhishwe eZezibalo eNingizimu Afrika, ebonise ukwehla kancane kwezinga labantu abangasebenzi lisuka kuma-32.9% kwikota yokuqala liya kuma-32.6% kwikota yesibili.

src: Cabinet is also pleased with 154 000 new jobs were created in the second quarter, taking the number of employed persons to million.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde layithakasela imisebenzi emisha eyizi-154 000 eyasungulwa kwikota yesibili, lokho okwenza ukuthi inani labantu abasebenzayo liyofikelela kwizigidi eziyi-.

src: This is the 7th quarter of consecutive gains in employment inching South Africa closer to pre-Covid-19 pandemic employment figure of million.
tgt: Lena sekuyikota yeSikhombisa ngokulandelana inani labasebenzayo linyuka eNingizimu Afrika nokusondela kakhulu kwinani eliyizigidi eziyi-16.4 langesikhathi sangaphambi kobhubhane i-COVID-19.

src: Cabinet has also noted the green shoots with the reduction of youth unemployment by 131,000 and an increase of 105,000 in the number of employed youth to million.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lakubona ukusimama komnotho ngenxa yokwehla kwezibalo zentsha engasebenzi ngezi-131 000 kanye nokwenyuka ngezi-105 000 kwizibalo zentsha esebenzayo zayoba yizigidi ezi-.

src: Consumer Price Inflation (CPI)3.
tgt: Ukukhuphuka Kwamanani Abathengi (i-CPI)3.

src: Cabinet further welcomed reports by StatsSA that the annual Consumer Price inflation slowed to 4.7% in July 2023, from 5.4% in June The annual inflation rate for goods was 5.5% for July 2023 from 6.3% in June 2023, whereas the inflation rate for services was 4.0% down from 4.5% in the same period.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela imibiko ye-StatsSA ethi Ukukhuphuka Kwamanani Abathengi kwaminyakayonke kwehlele ku-4.7% ngoNtulikazi wezi-2023, kusuka ku-5.4% ngoNhlangulana wezi-20.

src: Agro-Energy Fund to support agriculture and agribusinesses.
tgt: ISikhwama Sezolimo Nezamandla sokusiza ezolimo namabhizinisi ahlobene nezolimo.

src: On the 27th of August 2023, the Department of Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development, collaboratively with the Land Bank, launched a R1,21 billion Agro-Energy Fund to support the agriculture and agribusiness sector to install alternative energy sources and continue with food, fibre and beverages production.
tgt: Mhla wama-27 kuNcwaba 2023, uMnyango Wezolimo, Izinguquko Zomhlaba nokuThuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya ngokusebenza ngokubambisana ne-Land Bank, bethula iSikhwama Sezolimo Nezamandla sezigidigidi ezi-R.21 sokusiza umkhakha wezolimo nowamabhizinisi ahlobene nezolimo ukuthi bakwazi ukufaka ezinye izindlela zokuphehla ugesi futhi baqhubeke nokukhiqiza ukudla, i-fibre kanye neziphuzo.

src: The sector is one of the intensive energy users and critical for the stability of South Africa’s food security, export earnings and employment, thus making this government intervention vital to ensure sustainability.
tgt: Lo mkhakha ungomunye wabasebenzisa ugesi kakhulu futhi ubalulekile ekuletheni uzinzo ekutholakaleni kokudla eNingizimu Afrika, ukwenza inzuzo ngokuthunyelwa kwemikhiqizo kwamanye amazwe nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi, lokho okwenza ukuthi lokhu kungenelela kukahulumeni kubaluleke kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukusimama.

src: The Fund is inclusive and will support farming businesses of all scales in a Blended Finance approach, with the Land Bank managing the Fund.
tgt: ISikhwama lesi sibandakanya wonke umuntu futhi sizosiza wonke amabhizinisi alimayo nafuyayo ngendlela Edidiyelwe yezezimali, nokuzoba i-Land Bank elawula lesi sikhwama.

src: The Fund will also include all agriculture and agribusiness activities that are energy intensive.
tgt: ISikhwama sizophinde sisize yonke imisebenzi yezolimo kanye namabhizinisi ezolimo asebenzisa kakhulu ugesi.

src: Implementation of State Capture Commission recommendations The National Prosecuting Authority assets recovery is R.2 billion in the current MTEF period and R.55 billion of it is State Capture related.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kwezincomo zeKhomishini Ephenya Ngokuthunjwa Kwamandla Ombuso Impahla ebuyiswe nguPhiko Lukazwelonke Lwezokushushisa ibe yizigidigidi eziyi-R.2 kulesi sikhathi samanje se-MTEF kanti izigidigidi ezi-R.55 zayo le mpahla ihlobene nokuThunjwa Kwamandla Ombuso.

src: Cabinet has approved and tabled in Parliament eight of the fourteen new legislative amendments identified in our implementation plan.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze laphinde lenekela iPhalamende izichibiyelo ezintsha zomthetho eziyisishiyagalombili kweziyishumi nane ezicashunwe ohlelweni lokuqaliswa kwezincomo.

src: Work also continues to ensure that those responsible for state capture are held to account.
tgt: Umsebenzi nawo uyaqhubeka wokuqinisekisa ukuthi labo abanesandla ekuthunjweni kwamandla ombuso bayaphendula.

src: Fight against crime, corruption and illegal immigration The latest Quarterly Crime Statistics show that we must do more as a society to tackle the scourge of crime.
tgt: Ukulwa nobugebengu, inkohlakalo kanye nokuthuthela kwelinye izwe ngokungemthetho IZibalo Zobugebengu Zekota zakamuva zibonisa ukuthi kufanele senze okukhulu njengomphakathi ukulwisana nesihlava sobugebengu.

src: Cabinet calls on everyone to join the fight and to work collectively to make our homes, places of work and public spaces safer for all.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela bonke abantu ukuthi balwe futhi basebenze ngokubambisana ekwenzeni ukuthi amakhaya ethu, izindawo zethu zokusebenza kanye nezindawo zomphakathi ziphephile kuwona wonke umuntu.

src: Cabinet further welcomed the extension of the integrated crime-fighting “Operation Shanela” to other provinces, including the Northern Cape, Eastern Cape and KwaZulu-Natal.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela ukusatshalaliswa kohlelo oludidiyelwe lokulwa nobugebengu i-“Operation Shanela” kwezinye izifundazwe, kubandakanya eNyakatho Kapa, eMpumalanga Kapa naKwaZulu-Natali.

src: Cabinet noted the recent guilty plea and sentencing of six men accused of killing anti-corruption whistleblower, Ms Babita Deokaran, in August 2021.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukuvunywa kwamacala kanye nokugwetshwa kwamadoda ayisithupha ayesolwa ngokubulala loyo owayeyingede ekulwisaneni nenkohlakalo, uNks.

src: It called on law-enforcement agencies to further investigate and ensure that masterminds behind the murder are brought to book.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licele abezomthetho ukuthi baqhubeke baphenyisise futhi baqinisekise ukuthi ongqondongqondo baloku kubulala babhekana nomthetho.

src: Cabinet applauded the integrated approach in combating crime that recently led to the Department of Home Affairs intercepting 67 Pakistani nationals who tried to enter the country illegally at the OR Tambo International Airport on Sunday, 13 August 2023.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayele ihlombe indlela yokusebenza edidiyelwe yokulwa nobugebengu kamuva-nje eholele ekutheni uMnyango Wezasekhaya uvimbe abokubaduka e-Pakistan abangama-67 abebezama ukungena kuleli lizwe ngokungemthetho e-OR Tambo International Airport ngeSonto, mhla ziyi-13 kuNcwaba 2023.

src: Transforming MENtalities Summit 2023.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yokuguqula Ukucabanga Kwamadoda yowezi-2023.

src: The recently concluded Transforming MENtalities Summit has left an indelible mark on 1500 attendees, with its powerful engagement and insightful discussions poised to pave the way for transformation needs for men and boy behavior.
tgt: INgqungquthela Yokuguqula Ukucabanga Kwamadoda ephothulwe kamuva-nje ishiye uphawu olungacimeki kwizethameli eziyi-1 500, nebe nokuxoxisana okunamandla nokujulile okuphembe indlela yesidingo sezinguquko endleleni yokuziphatha yamadoda nabafana.

src: Held at the Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, the summit brought together University Vice-Chancellors, Deans, Principals and Council Chairpersons of TVET Colleges, Student Support Structures and Leadership, CEOs of SETAs, entities of the Departments of Higher Education and Science and Innovation, policymakers, survivors, peer educators, and change-makers, all unified by a shared commitment to addressing Gender-Based Violence (GBV) within the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ebibanjwe e-Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre, ihlanganise amaPhini oShansela Bamanyuvesi, iziNhloko Zamanyuvesi, oThishanhloko kanye noSihlalo beMikhandlu yamaKolishi Okuqeqesha, Izinhlangano Ezeseka Abafundi kanye Nobuholi, Abaphathi Abakhulu bama-SETA, izinhlangano zoMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme, iSayensi Nokuqamba Kabusha, abenza izinqubomgomo, abasinde ku-GBV, ama-peer educator, kanye nabeza noguquko, bonke bahlangane ngazwi linye lokuzinikela ekulweni noDlame Olubhekiswe Kwabobulili Obuthile (i-GBV) ngaphakathi emkhakheni wezemfundo ephakeme i-Post-School Education and Training (i-PSET).

src: The Summit was hosted by HIGHER HEALTH and the Human Science Research Council (HSRC) on behalf of the Department of Higher Education and Training and the Department of Science and Innovation.
tgt: Ingqungquthela beyisingathwe yi-HIGHER HEALTH kanye noMkhandlu Wezocwaningo Lwesayensi Yabantu (i-HSRC) omele uMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqeshwa kanye noMnyango Wezesayensi Nokuqamba Kabusha.

src: The aim was to engage the sector leadership, on transforming mentalities and address the root causes of GBEvidence and data suggest that men behavior has been one of the root causes of GBV and the Summit called for action for men and boys towards being part of the solution.
tgt: Inhloso yale ngqungquthela bekungukuxoxisana nobuholi, mayelana nokuguqula ukucabanga kanye nokubhekana nembangela engumnyombo we-GBUbufakazi nolwazi oluqoqiwe lubonisa ukuthi ukuziphatha kwamadoda yikona okuyimbangela ye-GBV kanti kule ngqungquthela kucelwe amadoda nabafana ukuthi babe yingxenye yesisombululo.

src: The summit asked for the development of more peer educators and champions across all our campuses, to work as change agents towards transforming MENtalities, more men dialogues across all institutions, incorporating gender studies including GBV, gender equality, gender diversity and transforming MENtalities as co-curriculum alongside the main curriculum in the Post-School Education and Training (PSET) sector.
tgt: Kule ngqungquthela kucelwe ukuthi kuthuthukiswe ama-peer educator nama-champions kuzona zonke izikhungo, abazosebenza njengama-change agents azosebenza ukuguqula indlela amadoda acabanga ngayo, kube nezinye izingxoxo zamadoda kuzona zonke izikhungo, kufakwe izifundo ezifundisa ngobulili kubandakanya ne-GBV, ukulingana kwezobulili, ukwahlukana ngobulili kanye nokuguqula ukucabanga kwamadoda njengezifundo ezizohambisana nohlelo lwezemfundo emkhakheni we-Post-School Education and Training (i-PSET).

src: Electricity Cabinet received an update on electricity situation in the country and noted reports of the continued improvement in electricity availability Although the last few days had recorded an increase in the load shedding stages to stage 4, the situation has since improved with the return of units to generation, and Eskom continues to taper down the load shedding stages.
tgt: Ezikagesi IKhabhinethi litshelwe ngesimo sikagesi kuleli lizwe laphinde layibona imibiko emayelana nokwenza ngcono okuqhubekayo endimeni yokutholakala kukagesi.

src: Cabinet was briefed that there are communities that have no electricity due to power outages and not load shedding.
tgt: Yize izinsuku ezedlule ezimbalwa zibonise ukwenyuka kwamazinga okucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga okufinyelele ezingeni leSine, isimo sibe ngcono ngokubuyiselwa kokusebenza kwamayunithi eziphehlimandla, kanti no-Eskom uyaqhubeka nokwehlisa amazinga okucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: The Minister of Electricity and the Department of COGTA have commenced with a programme to engage with the affected communities to agree on measures that will allow the replacement of damaged infrastructure but linked with the prohibition of illegal connections, community partnerships in the protection if electricity infrastructure, and payment for electricity service.
tgt: IKhabhinethi litshelwe kafushane ukuthi kunemiphakathi engenawo ugesi ngenxa yokuhamba kukagesi okungekona ukuthi ucinywe ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: South Africa’s Agreement with the Chinese companies, on recently signed agreements, will play a significant role in introducing electricity infrastructure with self preservation capability.
tgt: Lokhu kucima kukagesi kudalwa ukusindwa kukagesi ngenxa yokuxhunywa kukagesi ngokungemthetho, ukwebiwa nokucekelwa phansi kweziteshi kanye nama-transformer, kanye nokucekelwa phansi kwemigudu ethumela ugesi.

src: Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.1 Cabinet was briefed about the unconstitutional draft Western Cape Provincial Powers Bill.2 The Draft Bill violates the provisions of Schedules 4 and 5 of the Constitution that set out powers and functions including concurrent powers of both the provincial and National executives.
tgt: Imiphakathi ethintekayo ibandakanya izingxenye ze-Soweto, izingxenye zeThembisa, KwaThema, eKomane, e-Taung nase-Ditsobotla.

src: Cabinet has noted that this draft Bill is an attempt to revert back to the Democratic Party’s (forerunner to the Democratic Alliance) preferred federal approach that seeks to undermine a United and inclusive South Africa.4 It is noteworthy that WC draft Bill ignores the exclusion from access to services of the large black communities of Khayelitsha, Gugulethu, Nyanga, Langa, the Cape Flats, Delft, Central Line, amongst others Cabinet has mandated the Ministers of Justice and COGTA to enter into discussions with the Western Cape provincial government in line with the relevant dispute resolution mechanisms as provided for in section 146 of the Constitution and the applicable intergovernmental framework.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezikagesi kanye noMnyango we-COGTA sebeqalile nohlelo lokuxoxisana nemiphakathi ethintekayo ukuze bezovumelana ngezinyathelo ezizolungisa ingqalasizinda emoshekile kodwa ezizohambisana nokuvinjelwa kokuxhunywa kukagesi ngokungemthetho, ukubambisana komphakathi ukuvikela ingqalasizinda kagesi, kanye nokukhokhelwa kwezinsizakalo zikagesi.

src: The fund was established to assist minibus taxis, cabs and e-hailing drivers who were financially disadvantaged during the Coronavirus Disease hard lockdowns, in line with stipulated criteria.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukuthi lo Mthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo ungumzamo wokubuyela emuva endleleni eyayithandwa yi-Democratic Party (iqembu elandulela i-Democratic Alliance) ehlose ukubukela phansi iNingizimu Afrika eBumbene nebandakanya wonke umuntu.4 Kuyaqapheleka ukuthi lo Mthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo waseNtshonalanga Kapa ushaya indiva ukunqatshelwa ukufinyelela kwizinsizakalo zemiphakathi yabantu abamnyama emikhulu yaseKhayelitsha, eGugulethu, eNyanga, kwaLanga, e-Cape Flats, e-Delft, e-Central Line, phakathi kweminye.

src: Green Paper on the Development of Tourism in South Africa Cabinet approved the publication of the Green Paper on the Development of Tourism in South Africa for public comments.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze oNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa nowe-COGTA ukuthi bangene ezingxoxweni nohulumeni wesifundazwe saseNtshonalanga Kapa bakhulume ngezindlela ezifanele zokuza nesixazululo njengokusho kwesahluko se-146 soMthethosisekelo kanye nohlaka olufanele lwangaphakathi kuhulumeni.

src: The policy seeks to develop and promote tourism in South Africa, and address barriers to tourism growth.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi Ukwelulwa kwezinkokhelo zeSikhwama Sokusiza Osomatekisi IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukwelulwa kwesikhathi sezinkokhelo zeSikhwama Sokusiza Osomatekisi ngezinye izinyanga eziyi-12.

src: The policy seeks to address the historically institutionalised inequalities and disparities, which follow racial and economic access lines in theatre and dance.2 The policy aims to set a vision and practical policies, strategies, implementation mechanisms and time frames that will result in a sustainable and vibrant theatre and dance sector in all nine provinces, with South African dance and theatre makers representing the country with pride continentally and globally.
tgt: Isikhwama sasungulelwa ukusiza abashayeli bamatekisi, abama-cab kanye nabezimoto ezibizwa ngobuchwepheshe i-e-hailing abakhahlamezeka ngokwezimali ngesikhathi sokuvalwa thaqa kwezwe ngenxa yeSifo Segciwane i-Corona, ngokwemibandela ebekiwe.

src: Essential Food Price Monitoring Reports.1 The Competition Commission has been monitoring essential food prices pursuant to price gouging concerns raised since the declaration of the State of Disaster in March 2020.
tgt: Uhlaka Lomthetho wokuThuthukisa Ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lomthetho wokuThuthukisa Ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: The continuation of essential food price monitoring is motivated by the need to ensure affordable and accessible essential food products for consumers.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo ihlose ukuthuthukisa nokugqugquzela ezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika, kanye nokubhekana nemigoqo ekhona ekukhuleni kwezokuvakasha.

src: The Commission has noted the ‘rocket and feather’ effect, where prices are quick to rise often in excess of cost increases and slow to fall once cost pressures decline.
tgt: Inqubomgomo izophinde igqugquzele ezokuvakasha ezindaweni zasemakhaya neziseduzane kwamadolobha ngokugqugquzela ukuboniswa nokubonakala kwemikhiqizo ephuma ezindaweni zasemakhaya.

src: It has also flagged the concentrated nature of the food and retail markets as a concerning contributing factor.
tgt: Iziphakamiso zenqubomgomo ziphinde zigxile ekuphathweni komkhakha wezokuvakasha nokusebenzisana ukuphepha kanye nokuvikeleka uguquko kanye nokwamukela ubuchwepheshe, phakathi kwezinye izinto.

src: The Cabinet has noted the Commission’s recommended measures including market inquiries to address structural features in the market that lead to high food prices and low levels of competition.
tgt: UHlaka Lomthetho luyatholakala kwisizindalwazi esithi: WEBTOKEINqubomgomo kaZwelonke Kwezeshashalazi nokuDansa IKhabhinethi ligunyaze iNqubomgomo kaZwelonke Kwezeshashalazi nokuDansa.

src: Cabinet has approved that the Economic Cluster must put in place an action plan on food prices, food secure and access to food.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo kuhloswe ngayo ukuxazulula ukungalingani kwakudala kwangaphakathi kanye nokungafani, okulandela izindlela zokufinyelela ngokobuhlanga nangokomnotho kwezeshashalazi nokudansa.2 Inqubomgomo ihlose ukubeka umbono nemithethonqubo, amaqhingasu, izindlela zokuqalisa ukusebenza kwemithetho kanye nezikhathi ezibekiwe okuzoholela emkhakheni wezeshashalazi nokudansa osimeme nonomndlandla kuzozonke izifundazwe eziyisishiyagalolunye, kanye nabadansi nabadlali beshashalazi baseNingizimu Afrika abazomela izwe ngokuzigqaja ezwenikazini nasemhlabeni jikelele.

src: Algemene Vergadering van die Verenigde Nasies (UNGA) Die Kabinet het die toespraak deur President Cyril Ramaphosa by die 78ste UNGA wat van 18 tot 26 September 2023 in New York, Verenigde State van Amerika, gehou is, verwelkom.
tgt: UMhlangano Jikelele weZizwe Ezibumbene (i-UNGA) IKhabhinethi lamukele inkulumo kaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa kwi-UNGA yama-78 ebibanjelwe e-New York, e-United States of America kusuka mhla we-18 kuya mhla wama-26 kuMandulo 2023.

src: Die President se welkome toespraak het Suid-Afrika se voorvegtersposisie in die belange en gelyke en sinvolle deelname van die Afrika-kontinent en die globale Suide in die algemeen by die VN en ander multilaterale forums, herbevestig.
tgt: Inkulumo eyamukelwe kaMongameli iqinisekise ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ime kuphi ekwesekeni izimfuno, kanye nokuzibandakanya okulinganayo nokubonakalayo kwezwekazi i-Afrika kanye noMhlaba Oseningizimu jikelele kwi-UN nakwezinye izinkundla zamazwe ahlukahlukene.

src: Die toespraak het ook Suid-Afrika se vasberadenheid vir die steunmobilisering vir die volgende, herbevestig:
tgt: Le nkulumo iqinisekise ukuqina kweNingizimu Afrika ekugqugquzeleni ukwesekwa kwalokhu okulandelayo:

src: hernude toewyding aan multilateralisme, gebaseer op duidelike reëls en deur doeltreffende instansies ondersteun.
tgt: Ukuvuselelwa kokuzinikela ekusebenzisaneni kwamazwe ahlukahlukene, ngokulandela imithetho ecacile nokwesekwa kwezikhungo ezifanele.

src: die hervorming van die VN se Veiligheidsraad (VNVR) om sin te gee aan die beginsel van die soewereine gelykheid van nasies en om die VNVR in staat te stel om meer doeltreffend op huidige geopolitieke werklikhede, te reageer.
tgt: Ukuguqulwa koMkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka we-UN (i-UNSC), lokho okuzoholela ekulinganeni kwamazwe nokuzovumela i-UNSC ukuthi ixazulule ngendlela eyimpumelelo izinkinga ezikhona zepolitiki.

src: welaf lande moet finansiële steun vermeerder om die 2023 Agenda vir volhoubare Ontwikkeling te implementeer en hul klimaatsveranderingsdoelwitte op omvattende en geïntegreerde wyse te bereik, waaronder die behoefte om dringend die werksaamhede van die Verlies- en Skadefonds vir kwesbare lande wat hard deur klimaatsrampe getref is, soos in November 2022 deur die 27ste sessie van die Konferensie van die Partye in Egipte ooreengekom is.
tgt: Amazwe acebile azokhuphula uxhaso ngokwezimali ukuze kuzoqaliswa ukusebenza kwe-Ajenda yowezi-2023 YeNtuthuko Esimeme kanye nokufeza izinjongo zokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu ngendlela ecacile nedidiyelwe, kubandakanya nesidingo sokuqalisa ngokuphuthuma ukusebenza kwesikhwama i-Loss and Damage Fund esizosiza amazwe abuthakathaka ashayeke kakhulu izinhlekelele ezidalwa isimo sezulu, njengoba kwavunyelwana kwiSeshini yama-27 yeNgqungquthela Yamaqembu eyayibanjwe e-Egypt ngoLwezi wezi-2022.

src: President Ramaphosa het Suid-Afrika se toewyding om steeds klimaatsverandering aan te spreek en die land as ŉ leier in hernubare energie, groen waterstof en volhoubare industrialisasie te posisioneer, herbevestig.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uqinisekise ukuzinikela kweNingizimu Afrika ekuqhubekeni nokubhekana nokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu nokuthi leli lizwe lizohamba phambili kwezamandla avuselelekayo, ihayidrojini enganukubezi imvelo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezimboni okusimeme.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook die Spitsberaad vir die bevordering van pandemievoorkoming, -gereedheid en -reaksie, in sy hoedanigheid as die Afrika-unie se kampioen vir die reaksie op die Koronavirussiekte (KOVID-19), toegespreek.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wakhuluma kwiNgqungquthela Yokugwema, Ukulungela kanye Nokubhekana neZifo Ezilubhubhane, ngokwesikhundla sakhe njenge-African Union Champion yeZindlela Zokubhekana Nesifo Segciwane i-Corona (i-COVID-19).

src: Suid-Afrika se bilaterale program op die kantlyn van die 78ste UNGA President Ramaphosa het op die kantlyn van die 78ste UNGA ŉ regeringsafvaardiging gelei wat verskeie bilaterale vergaderings belê het wat gepoog het om strategiese, politieke, diplomatieke en handelsverhoudinge te versterk.
tgt: Uhlelo lwamazwe amabili lweNingizimu Afrika oluqhubeke ngesikhathi se-UNGA yama-78 Ngesikhathi kuqhubeka i-UNGA yama-78, uMongameli u-Ramaphosa uhole ithimba likahulumeni elibambe imihlangano eminingana yamazwe amabili inhloso yayo kungukuqinisa ubudlelwano ngokwamacebo, ngokwepolitiki, ubunxusa kanye nobudlelwano kwezokuhweba.

src: Die President het met sy Oekraïniese eweknie, Volodymyr Zelensky, vergader om vordering aangaande die vertroue-opbouingsmaatreëls en ander ontwikkelings deur die Afrika-vrede-inisiatief te bespreek.
tgt: UMongameli uhlangane nozakwabo wase-Ukraine u-Volodymyr Zelensky ukuze bazodingida ngenqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe ngezinyathelo zoMzamo Wokuletha Ukuthula nokubuyisa ukuzethemba kanye nokunye ukuthuthuka.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook vergader met:2.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wahlangana nalaba abalandelayo:2.

src: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan van Turkye aangaande die versterking van verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika en Turkye, en hulle het mekaar ingelig oor die vredesinisiatiewe oor die konflik tussen Rusland en Oekraïne.
tgt: UMongameli u-Recep Tayyip Erdoğan wase-Türkiye, badingida ngokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Turkey, nokudlana indlebe mayelana nemizamo yokuletha ukuthula kwingxabano phakathi kwe-Russia ne-Ukraine.

src: President Bola Tinubu van die Federale Republiek van Nigerië oor die versterking van verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika en Nigerië.
tgt: UMongameli u-Bola Tinubu wase-Federal Republic of Nigeria, badingida ngokuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Nigeria.

src: Hy het ook die jongste nuus ontvang oor die inisiatief deur die Ekonomiese Gemeenskap van Wes-Afrikastate oor die staatsgreep in Niger en algemene pogings om demokratiese bevel in die Sahel te herstel.
tgt: Uphinde watshelwa ngohlelo olubenzima loMnotho Wamazwe aseNtshonalanga ye-Afrika e-Nigeria kanye nemizamo yokubuyisa ukubusa ngentando yeningi e-Sahel.

src: President Emmerson Mnangagwa van die Republiek van Zimbabwe, oor inisiatiewe deur Zimbabwe se regering om die herbou van daardie land na die onlangse geharmoniseerde verkiesings, te konsolideer.
tgt: UMongameli u-Emmerson Mnangagwa waseRiphabhulikhi yase-Zimbabwe, lapho bedingide ngezinhlelo zikahulumeni wase-Zimbabwe zokuhlanganisa ukwakhiwa kabusha kwaleliya lizwe emva kokhetho lwakamuva olube nokuthula.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook deelgeneem aan die ronde tafelbespreking oor besigheid van die Verenigde State-Suid-Afrikaanse handel en beleggings, wat Suid-Afrikaanse en Amerikaanse sakeleiers ingesluit het.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wabamba iqhaza eMhlanganweni Wezohwebo Notshalomali phakathi kwe-United States (i-US) kanye neNingizimu Afrika, obubandakanya abaholi bamabhizinisi baseNingizimu Afrika nabaseMelika.

src: Dié vergadering was kernbelangrik vir die voortdurende versterking van verhoudings tussen Suid-Afrika en die VSA, met meer as 600 VSA-maatskappye wat in Suid-Afrika bedrywig is.
tgt: Njengoba kunezinkampani ezingaphezu kwama-600 zase-US ezisebenza lapha eNingizimu Afrika, le nguyazana ibibaluleke kakhulu ezingxoxweni eziqhubekayo zokuqinisa amaxhama phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-UNgesikhathi kuqhubeka le ngqungquthela, kumenyezelwe ngokusemthethweni ukuthi i-US-Sub-Saharan Africa Trade and Economic Cooperation Forum yama-20, (i-AGOA Forum) izobanjelwa eGoli kusuka mhla wesi-2 kuya mhla wesi-4 kuLwezi 2023.

src: ŉ Formele aankondiging is in daardie tydperk gemaak dat die 20ste handels- en ekonomiese samewerkingsforum vir die VSA en Sub-Sahara Afrika (AGOA-forum) vanaf 2 tot 4 November 2023 in Johannesburg sal plaasvind.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela izoba nombukiso obizwa nge-‘Made in Africa Exhibition’ ozobe ubukisa ngobuxhakaxhaka bemikhiqizo yezwekazi.

src: President Ramaphosa het ook die aankondiging van die medewerking tussen Novo Nordisk en Aspen, betrag.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa uphinde wazizwela ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwe-Novo Nordisk ne-Aspen.

src: Die medewerking sal tot die vervaardiging van insulien by Aspen se fasiliteite in Gqebera, in die Oos-Kaap, lei.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana kuzoholela ekukhiqizweni kwekhambi lokwelapha ushukela i-insulin ezikhungweni zase-Aspen eGqeberha, eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Die medewerking poog om in 2024 meer as 16 miljoen dosisse insulien te verskaf, wat in 2026 vermeerder sal word.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana kuhloswe ngakho ukuthumela imithamo engaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-16 ze-insulin ngowezi-2024, okuzokwengezwa ngowezi-2026.

src: Dit sal toegang tot insulienbehandeling in Suid-Afrika en regoor die kontinent, verhoog.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza ngcono ukuthi ukwelashwa nge-insulin kutholakale hhayi kuphela eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa kulolonke izwekazi.

src: Die Kabinet het die Nasionale Energiereguleerder van Suid-Afrika se goedkeuring van handels- en invoer-/uitvoerlisensie-aansoeke aan die Nasionale Transmissiemaatskappy van Suid-Afrika, verwelkom, wat die weg vir die verkryging van krag regoor die streek, baan.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele ukuthi i-National Energy Regulator of South Africa igunyaze ukuhweba kanye nezicelo zemvume yokuthumela nokwamukela impahla kwamanye amazwe kwe-National Transmission Company of South Africa, lokho okuzophemba indlela yokuthengwa kukagesi esifundeni jikelele.

src: Die Kusile-kragstasie se eenheid 4 wat na beplande onderhoud weer operasioneel is, het 800 megawatt in ons kragnetwerk ingestoot.
tgt: Ukusebenza futhi kwe-Unit 4 esiteshini sikagesi i-Kusile Power Station emva kokulungiswa obekuhleliwe kubuyise ugesi ongama-800 megawatts kwisizinda sikagesi.

src: Dié mylpaal is kernbelangrik vir die verbetering van opwekkingskapasiteit vir die nasionale netwerk en die aanspreek van die frekwensie van beurtkrag.
tgt: Lo msebenzi ubaluleke kakhulu ekuthuthukiseni umthamo wokuphehlwa kukagesi kwisizinda sikagesi sikazwelonke kanye nokubhekana namazinga okucinywa kukagesi ngenhloso yokuwonga.

src: Die Kabinet is verder ingelig oor die vordering om die Kusile-kragstasie se eenheid 1, 2 en 3 vroeg operasioneel te maak.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liphinde latshelwa kafushane ngenqubekelaphambili yokulungisa ama-Unit 1, 2 no-3 e-Kusile Power Station ngaphambi kwesikhathi ebesibekiwe.

src: Die Kabinet het Eskom se stabiele beoordeling deur Moody se Beleggersdiens verwelkom, wat die kragnutsdiens se kredietwaardigheid sal verbeter en hom in staat sal stel om vooruit te beplan oor die implementering van beplande onderhoud van sy opwekkingsvloot.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lamukele imiphumela yokuhlolwa kozinzo lwe-Eskom okwenziwe yi-Moody’s Investors Service, okuzokwenza ngcono ukusebenza kweziphehlimandla zikagesi futhi kuvumele ukuthi kuhlelwe kusenesikhathi ukunakekelwa kweziphehlimandla.

src: Watersekerheid.
tgt: Ukutholakala kwamanzi.

src: Die Kabinet is ingelig oor pogings om wateruitdagings wat ŉ aantal gebiede regoor die land raak, aan te spreek.
tgt: IKhabhinethi litshelwe kafushane ngemizamo yokubhekana nezinselele zamanzi ezithinta izindawo eziningana ezweni lonkana.

src: Die Minister van Water en Sanitasie, Mnr Senzo Mchunu, en uitvoerende burgemeesters van sommige van die stede in Gauteng sal die jongste nuus oor voortdurende ingrypings om watertoevoer in die provinsie te stabiliseer, bekend maak.
tgt: Senzo Mchunu kanye nezimeya zamanye amadolobhakazi ase-Gauteng bazokhipha imibiko yokwazisa ngezingenelelo eziqhubekayo zokuletha uzinzo ekuthunyelweni kwamanzi esifundazweni.

src: Die Kabinet wil graag almal daaraan herinner dat Suid-Afrika ŉ waterskaarsland is.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lifisa ukukhumbuza wonke umuntu ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyizwe elintula amanzi.

src: Alle Suid-Afrikaners en almal in dié land moet water spaar en spaarsamig gebruik.
tgt: Bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika nawowonke umuntu okuleli lizwe kufanele bonge futhi basebenzise amanzi ngokuwonga.

src: Handelsake.
tgt: Ezohwebo.

src: Die vergadering van die Suid-Afrika-Lesotho binasionale kommissie (BNK) en die ministeriële kluster Die vergadering van die Suid-Afrika-Lesotho binasionale kommissie (BNK) en die ministeriële kluster wat van 25 tot 28 September 2023 gehou sal word, fokus op ekonomiese samewerking, oorkruis-grenskwessies en die beweging van mense, goedere en dienste tussen die twee lande.
tgt: IKhomishini Yamazwe Amabili okuyiNingizimu Afrika ne-Lesotho (i-BNC) kanye noMhlangano WoNgqongqoshe I-BNC yeNingizimu Afrika ne-Lesotho kanye noMhlangano Wongqongqoshe obubanjwe mhla zingama-25 kuya mhla zingama-28 kuMandulo 2023 ugxile ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana kwezomnotho, izinkinga zokweqa imingcele, kanye nokuhamba ngokukhululeka kwabantu, impahla kanye nezinsizakalo phakathi kwala mazwe amabili.

src: President Ramaphosa en die Eerste Minister, Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane, sal op Donderdag, 28 September 2023 medevoorsitters van die openingsessie van die BNK tussen Suid-Afrika en Lesotho, wees.
tgt: UMongameli u-Ramaphosa kanye noNdunankulu u-Samuel Ntsokoane Matekane bazobambisana ngokuba ngosihlalo kwiSeshini Yokuqala ye-BNC phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Lesotho ngoLwesine, mhla wama-28 kuMandulo 2023.

src: Die BNK sal diplomatieke verhoudings, verdediging en sekuriteit, water, vervoer, elektrisiteit en handel, bespreek.
tgt: Kule BNC kuzodingidwa ngobudlelwano bamanxusa, ezokuzivikela nokuvikeleka, amanzi, ezokuthutha, ugesi kanye nezohwebo.

src: Aanlynbemiddelingsplatform-markondersoek.
tgt: Inkundla Yezobuchwepheshe Exazulula Izinkinga Zezimakethe.

src: Die Kabinet het ŉ verslag ontvang van die mededingingskommissie oor die bevindings en herstellende handelinge oor die aanlynbemiddelingsplatform-markondersoek.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithole umbiko obuya kwiKhomishini Yezokuncintisana omayelana nokutholakele kanye nezinyathelo zokulungisa iNkundla Yezobuchwepheshe Exazulula Izinkinga Zezimakethe.

src: Die Kabinet het die werk van die kommissie verwelkom aangaande die aanspreek van monopoliekommerpunte in digitale bemiddelingsplatforms, waaronder e-handel, aanlynreisagentskappe, voedselaflewering, toepassingswinkels, snuffelgidsverskaffers en soekenjins.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lincome umsebenzi wekhomishini ekubhekaneni nezikhalazo zokuba nomthengisi oyedwa ezinkundleni zedijithali, kubandakanya i-ecommerce, ama-ejensi ezokuvakasha, ukuhanjiswa kokudla, ama-app store, abezikhangiso kanye nezinjini zokubheka okuthile ngobuchwepheshe.

src: Die Kabinet het aan die ministers van toepaslike regeringsdepartemente opdrag gegee om verder by die aanbevelings vir verbetering betrokke te raak, die beleidsimplikasies te oorweeg en die nodige beleidsverbeterings te onderneem wat sinvolle deelname van Suid-Afrikaners en klein-, medium- en mikro-ondernemings oor die ontwikkelende aanlynbesighede, sal vergemaklik.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyalele oNgqongqoshe beminyango kahulumeni efanele ukuthi baqhubeke balandele izincomo ukwenza ngcono isimo, babheke imithelela yenqubomgomo baphinde balandele izinguquko ezifanele zenqubomgomo ezizobhekelela ukubandakanyeka kwabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye namabhizinisi amancane nasafufusa ekukhuleni kwamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe.

src: Voëlgriep.
tgt: Umkhuhlane wezinyoni.

src: Die Kabinet neem kennis van die huidige uitbraak van die uiters patogeniese influensa (HPAI) H5 en H7 in die pluimvee-industrie in Suid-Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likuqaphele ukuthi kunokuqubuka okukhona komkhuhlane obanga isifo (i-HPAI) H5 ne-H7 embonini yezinkukhu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Die Wes-Kaap en KwaZulu-Natal het uitbrekings van HPAI H5 ervaar, en HPAI H7 is in Gauteng-, Limpopo-, Mpumalanga- en die Noordwesprovinsie, gerapporteer.
tgt: INtshonalanga Kapa neKwaZulu-Natali babhekane nokuqubuka kwe-HPAI H5 kanti i-HPAI H7 kubikwe ukuthi ihlasele esifundazweni sase-Gauteng, e-Limpopo, eMpumalanga naseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Beheermaatreëls om die verspreiding van die uitbraak te beheer is in plek en boere word aangemoedig om voorgeskrewe bioveiligheidsmaatreëls, na te kom.
tgt: Izinyathelo zokunqanda nokulawula ukubhebhetheka komkhuhlane zime ngomumo futhi nabalimi bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi balandele izindlela zokuvikeleka abanikezwe zona.

src: Die uitbrekings stel voedselsekerheidsrisiko’s, en handelsmaatreëls in die vorm van invoere om vir die beskikbaarheid van vrugbare eiers, tafeleiers en pluimveevleis te sorg, kan geïmplementeer word.
tgt: Lo mkhuhlane ufaka engcupheni ukutholakala kokudla kanti kungahle kuthathwe izinyathelo zokuhweba ezifana nokuthola ukudla kwamanye amazwe ukuze kuzolawuleka ukutholakala kwamaqanda avundile, amaqanda alungele ukudliwa kanye nenyama yenkukhu.

src: Die Departement van Landbou, Grondhervorming en Landelike Ontwikkeling, die Suid-Afrikaanse Reguleringsowerheid vir Gesondheidsprodukte en die industrie ondersoek aansoeke vir die registrasie van moontlike entstowwe, met nakomingsmaatreëls verwant aan veiligheid, doeltreffendheid en kwaliteit wat van die grootste belang vir die registrasie van sodanige entstowwe is.
tgt: UMnyango Wezolimo, Ukuguqulwa Komhlaba Nokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya, iZiphathimandla Ezilawula Imikhiqizo Yezempilo eNingizimu Afrika kanye nemboni yonkana bahlolisisa izicelo zokubhaliswa kwemigomo engasetshenziswa, ngokulandela izinyathelo ezihambiselana nokuphepha, ukusebenza kahle kanye nobukhethelo ukuthi kube yikho okubekwe phambili uma kubhaliswa le migomo.

src: Geïntegreerde stryd teen misdaad Die Kabinet het die jongste nuus oor die stryd teen geweld verwelkom, wat ook deur die Minister van Polisie, Generaal Bheki Cele, en die Nasionale Gesamentlike Operasionele en Intelligensiestruktuur, aan die nasie verskaf is.
tgt: Uhlelo oludidiyelwe lokulwa nobugebengu IKhabhinethi lamukele umbiko wakamuva omayelana nokulwisana nobugebengu, ophinde wethulelwa isizwe nguNgqongqoshe Wamaphoyisa, uJenene Bheki Cele, kanye ne-National Joint Operational and Intelligence Structure.

src: Die multidissiplinêre werksaamheid oor onwettige mynbou en immigrasie in die Noord-Kaap het die arrestasie van 867 mense, baie vanaf Lesotho, Zimbabwe, Mosambiek en sommige Suid-Afrikaners, tot gevolg gehad.
tgt: Umkhankaso omikhakhaminingi wokulwisana nokumba izimayini ngokungemthetho kanye nokuthuthela kwamanye amazwe ngokungemthetho eNyakatho Kapa kuholele ekuboshweni kwabantu abangama-867, abaningi okungabase-Lesotho, e-Zimbabwe, e-Mozambique kanye nabanye abangalapha eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Die Kabinet het die sentimente van wetstoepassingsagentskappe herhaal dat Suid-Afrikaners wat skuilplekke aan kriminele betrokke in onwettige mynaktiwiteite verleen, die volle mag van die gereg in die gesig sal staar.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligcizelele umbono wama-ejensi aqinisekisa ukugcinwa komthetho ukuthi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abafuye izinswelaboya ezibandakanyeka ekumbeni izimayini ngokungemthetho bazobhekana nengalo yomthetho.

src: Die land se uiterste weerpatrone beklemtoon die impak wat klimaatsverandering op ons lewens het en die behoefte aan volgehoue optrede om ons ekonomie te ontkool terwyl volhoubare ontwikkeling nagestreef word.
tgt: Isimo sezulu esibi siqinisekisa umphumela wokuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu ezimpilweni zethu kanye nesidingo sokuthatha isinyathelo sokuguqukela kumnotho wekhabhoni ephansi ngesikhathi silwela ukuzinza kwentuthuko.

src: Die Kabinet bly ingelig oor die verwoesting wat deur erge storms en vloede in die Oos-Kaap, Wes-Kaap en Gauteng veroorsaak is, met aanduidings dat dit waarskynlik na ander provinsies sal versprei.
tgt: IKhabhinethi laziswe ngokukhahlamezeka okudalwe izivunguvungu nezikhukhula ezimbi eMpumalanga Kapa, eNtshonalanga Kapa nase-Gauteng, nokunezinkomba zokuthi zingahle zidlulele kwezinye izifundazwe.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op gemeenskappe om baie waaksaam vir verdere uiterste weerwaarskuwings, wat verdere verwoesting regoor die land kan veroorsaak, te wees.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela yonke imiphakathi ukuthi ihlale iqaphe ngeso lokhozi kwezinye izexwayiso zesimo sezulu esibi, esingaletha okunye ukukhahlamezeka ezweni lonkana.

src: Die regering ondersteun steeds nooddienste en rampbestuursentrums vir reddingsbedrywighede en om humanitêre steun te bied.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokweseka abezimo eziphuthumayo kanye nezikhungo ezilawula inhlekelele ukuthi basebenze ngokuphepha kanye nokunikeza usizo kubantu.

src: Winnie Mandelalaan Die Kabinet neem kennis van die herbenoeming van William Nicollaan in Sandton na Winnie Mandelalaan as ŉ belangrike stap in die herskryf van die geskiedenis van Suid-Afrika om die bydrae van diegene wat vir ons vryheid geveg het, te weerspieël.
tgt: Umgwaqo u-Winnie Mandela Avenue IKhabhinethi likuphawulile ukushintshwa komgwaqo u-William Nicol Drive e-Sandton waba ngu-Winnie Mandela Avenue njengesinyathelo esibalulekile sokubhala kabusha umlando waseNingizimu Afrika nozoqhayisa ngegalelo lalabo abalwela inkululeko yethu.

src: Die geleentheid het op 26 September oorvleuel met wat Winnie Madikizela-Mandela se 87ste verjaardag sou gewees het.
tgt: Lo mcimbi uhambisane nosuku lokuzalwa luka-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela lapho ebezobe egubha iminyaka yokuzalwa engama-87 mhla wama-26 kuMandulo 2023.

src: Kabinetsbesluite Bygewerkte wildsvleisstrategie vir Suid-Afrika Die Kabinet het die bygewerkte wildsvleisstrategie vir Suid-Afrika, wat poog om die wildsvleisindustrie te formaliseer en transformeer, goedgekeur.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi IQhingasu Elibuyekeziwe Lenyama Yenyamazane leNingizimu Afrika IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuqaliswa kweQhingasu Elibuyekeziwe Lenyama Yenyamazane leNingizimu Afrika, okuhloswe ngalo ukusebenza ngokulandela imithetho kanye nokuguqula imboni yenyama yenyamazane.

src: Die strategie poog om die wildsvleissektor as beide verskaffer van voedselsekerheid en ŉ ekonomiese groeisektor wat kan help om werk te skep, te versterk.
tgt: Leli qhingasu kuhloswe ngalo ukuqinisa umkhakha wenyama yenyamazane njengabahlinzeki bokudla kanye nomkhakha okhulisa umnotho futhi ongaba nesandla ekusungulweni kwemisebenzi.

src: Suid-Afrika is eerste op die Afrikakontinent vir wildsvleisproduksie, gelys.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika ibalwa njengephuma phambili ezwenikazini i-Afrika ngokukhiqiza inyama yenyamazane.

src: Die strategie poog om teen 2030 die skep van 202 666 volhoubare werke in die wildsvleisindustrie te verseker.
tgt: Iqhingasu leli lihlose ukuqinisekisa ukusungulwa kwemisebenzi esimeme eyizi-202 666 embonini yenyama yenyamazane uma kushaya unyaka wezi-2030.

src: Die strategie sal op die Departement van omgewing, bosbou en visserye se webwerf, WEBTOKEN, gepubliseer word.
tgt: Leli qhingasu lizoshicilelwa kwisizindalwazi soMnyango Wezamahlathi, Ukudoba Nemvelo ku: WEBTOKEUHlelo Olukhulu Lomkhakha Wezokuvakasha IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukuhanjelaniswa koHlelo Lokuvuselela Umkhakha Wezokuvakasha kanye noHlelo Olukhulu Lomkhakha Wezokuvakasha olusha.

src: Toerismesektormeesterplan Die Kabinet het die in ooreenstemming bring van die toerismesektorherstelplan met ŉ nuwe toerismemeesterplan, goedgekeur.
tgt: Ingxenye ebalulekile yoHlelo Olukhulu ngukuqeda nya ngemithelela yobhubhane lwe-COVID-19 emkhakheni wezokuvakasha.

src: ŉ Belangrike komponent van die meesterplan is om die impak van die KOVID-19-pandemie op die toerismesektor, te versag.
tgt: Luphinde luhlinzeke ngomhlahlandlela wokuvuselelwa kwezokuvakasha kuleli lizwe.

src: Die plan verskaf ook ŉ padkaart vir die volle herstel van toerisme in die land.
tgt: Ngesikhathi uHlelo Lokuvuselelwa Komkhakha Wezokuvakasha lwasungulelwa ukuqapha ukuvuselelwa kwalo mkhakha, ukugcinwa kwemisebenzi kanye nokuvikela indlela yabantu yokuziphilisa, uHlelo Olukhulu Lwezokuvakasha lona luzothatha lo msebenzi uluse kwelinye izinga futhi uqaphe amathuba amasha kulo mkhakha.

src: Die toerismesektorherstelplan is ontwikkel om die herstel van die sektor te vergemaklik, werke te behou en lewensbestaan te beskerm en die meesterplan wil dié werk na ŉ ander vlak neem en nuwe geleenthede in die sektor bevorder.
tgt: Uhlelo lolu luhlongoza amaqhinga ayisikhombisa okungenelela ukuze kuzoqinisekiswa ukuthi umkhakha wezokuvakasha ubuyela kuleziya zikhathi ezinhle, nokuthi uba ngummongo wokusungulwa kwemisebenzi nokuvulwa kwamabhizinisi amasha.

src: Die toerisme-industrie is ŉ noodsaaklike ekonomie en het voor die KOVID-19-pandemie 725 000 werke ondersteun.
tgt: Imboni yezokuvakasha inegalelo elibalulekile emnothweni kanti isize ngemisebenzi eyizi-725 000 ngaphambi kokuhlasela kobhubhane lwe-COVID-19.

src: Wetsontwerpe.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: Wetsontwerp op Suid-Afrikaanse Uitsaaikorporasie (SABC) van 2023.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa weNkampani Yezokusakaza eNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) wangowezi-2023.

src: Die Kabinet het die voorlegging van SABC-wetsontwerp van 2023 aan die Parlement, goedgekeur.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukulethwa koMthethosivivinywa we-SABC wezi- ePhalamende.

src: Die wetsontwerp sal, sodra dit aangeneem word, die herroeping van die huidige Uitsaaiwet, 1999 (Wetnr 4 van 1999) tot gevolg hê.
tgt: Uma usuphasisiwe waba ngumthetho, uMthethosivivinywa uzochitha uMthetho Wezokusakaza, wangowe-1999 (Umthetho wesi-4 we-1999) okhona njengamanje.

src: Die wysigings sal die doeltreffendheid van die openbare uitsaaier se bedrywighede, versterk.
tgt: Izichibiyelo zizoqinisa ukusebenza kahle kwendlela yokusebenza yabasakazi bomphakathi.

src: Die wetsontwerp stel ook verbeterings van die SABC se befondsingsmodel en die TV-lisensiëringstelsel, voor.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uphinde uhlongoze izinguquko kwindlela yokuxhasa ngezimali i-SABC kanye nendlela yokukhishwa kwamalayisensi e-TUMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Osahlongozwa Wezinsizakalo Zamanzi IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op waterdienste Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Konsepwysigingswetsontwerp op waterdienste vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: Izinhlosonqangi zalo Mthethosivivinywa ngukuqinisa ukuphendula kwabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi kanye nokwethula uhlelo lokusebenzela obala kungafihlwa lutho.

src: Die sleuteloogmerke van die wetsontwerp is om aanspreeklikheid vir waterdiensverskaffers te versterk en deursigtigheid in te bring.
tgt: Izichibiyelo zoMthetho Wezinsizakalo Zamanzi, we-1997 (Umthetho we-108 we-1997) zizoqinisekisa ukuthi abahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi bathumela amanzi asemgangathweni ophezulu ngokuya ngemibandela yamalayisensi abo.

src: Die wysigings sal ook swak punte aanspreek wat in die waterdienssektor uitgewys is.
tgt: Izichibiyelo zizophinde zibhekana nezinkinga ezibonakale kumkhakha wezinsizakalo zamanzi.

src: Die wetsontwerp stel minimumstandaarde vir die funksionering van waterdiensverskaffers, wat deur waterdiensowerhede toegepas moet word.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa ubeke ubuncane bezindinganiso zabahlinzeki bezinsizakalo zamanzi, okufanele iziphathimandla zeZinsizakalo Zamanzi ziqinisekise ukuthi ziyalandelwa.

src: Nasionale waterkonsepwysigingswetsontwerp Die Kabinet het die publikasie van die Nasionale waterkonsepwysigingswetsontwerp vir openbare kommentaar goedgekeur.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Osahlongozwa Wezamanzi Kuzwelonke.

src: Die wetsontwerp wysig die Nasionale Waterwet, 1998 (Wetnr 36 van 1998).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ligunyaze ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela osahlongozwa Wezamanzi Kuzwelonke ukuze umphakathi uzophawula ngawo.

src: Dié wysigings sal regulasies verbeter en sal verseker dat die land se waterhulpbronne goed bestuur, beskerm en bewaar word.
tgt: Lezi zichibiyelo zizothuthukisa imithethonqubo futhi zizoqinisekisa ukuthi imithombo yamanzi kuleli lizwe iphethwe kahle, ivikelekile futhi iyalondolozwa.

src: Die wetsontwerp maak ook voorstelle om die wanbalanse van die verlede verwant aan watertoewysing te elimineer en maak voorsiening vir doeltreffende en vinniger interne geskilbeslegtingsmeganismes.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uzophinde wenze iziphakamiso zokuqeda nya ukungalingani esikhathini esidlule okuhlobene nokuphakelwa kwamanzi, uphinde uhlinzeke ngezindlela ezisebenzayo nezisheshayo zokuxazulula izingxabano zangaphakathi.

src: Aanstellings Alle aanstellings is onderhewig aan die verifikasie van kwalifikasies en toepaslike klaring.
tgt: Abaqashiwe Bonke abaqashiwe kufanele kuqinisekiswe iziqu zabo zemfundo kanye nokuhlolwa okufanele.

src: Mnr Kuberndran Moodley as Hoofbestuurder: Vervaardiging en Ingenieurswese by Government Printing Works.
tgt: Kuberndran Moodley esikhundleni sokuba nguMphathi Jikelele: Kwezokukhiqiza Nobunjiniyela e-Government Printing Works.

src: Mnr Sihle Ngubane as Hoofbestuurder: Bedryfsbestuur by die Government Printing Works.
tgt: Sihle Ngubane esikhundleni sokuba nguMphathi Jikelele: Kwezokuphathwa Kwemisebenzi e-Government Printing Works.

src: Me Mmolaeng Mooki as Hoofbestuurder: Korporatiewe dienste by die Government Printing Works.
tgt: Mmolaeng Mooki esikhundleni sokuba nguMphathi Jikelele: Kwizinsizakalo zeNkampani e-Government Printing Works.

src: Aanstelling van nie-uitvoerende direkteure by die raad van die Suid-Afrikaanse spesiale risikoversekeringsvereniging.
tgt: Ukubekwa kwabaqondisi abangebona abaphathi beBhodi le-South African Special Risk Insurance Association.

src: Aanstelling van nie-uitvoerende direkteure by die raad van die ontwikkelingsbank van Suider-Afrika Mnr Bongani Nqwabana (heraanstelling).
tgt: Ukubekwa kwabaqondisi abangebona baphathi beBhodi le-Development Bank of Southern Africa.

src: Omstandigheidskwessies 2023 Rugby Wêreldbeker-kampioene Die Kabinet wens die Springbokke geluk met hul 2023 Rugby Wêreldbeker-oorwinning, wat gemaak het dat Suid-Afrika die enigste land is wat die Rugby Wêreldbeker vier (4) keer gewen het en die tweede land wat daarin kon slaag om die titel agtereenvolgens te wen.
tgt: OShampeni Bomhlaba Bebhola Lombhoxo ngowezi-2023 IKhabhinethi lihalalisele iqembu lama-Springboks ekunqobeni kwalo iNdebe Yomhlaba Yebhola Lombhoxo ngowezi-2023 nokwenze ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ibe ilona kuphela lizwe elinqobe iNdebe Yomhlaba yebhola Lombhoxo izikhawu ezine (4) kanye nelesibili ukunqoba izikhawu zilandelana.

src: In die geskiedenis van rugby in Suid-Afrika is hierdie die mees diverse Springbokspan wat Suid-Afrika se demografiese verteenwoordiging betref.
tgt: Emlandweni webhola lombhoxo eNingizimu Afrika, leli qembu lama-Springboks liyiqembu elahlukehlukene kakhulu uma ubheka ukwahlukana kwemvelaphi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Die samestelling van so ŉ diverse span was nie toevallig nie, maar ŉ doelbewuste poging deur die Springbokke se bestuur en afrigters om ŉ inklusiewe span te kies.
tgt: Ukudidiyelwa kwaleli qembu elahlukahlukene kanje akuzenzekelanga, kodwa kube ngumsebenzi wabaphathi nabaqeqeshi bama-Springboks wokukhetha iqembu elingacwasi muntu.

src: Daardie waagmoedige besluit deur die destydse afrigter, Rassie Erasmus, en sy span demonstreer aan Suid-Afrikaners sowel as die res van die wêreld dat enigeen met vaardigheid, gegewe ŉ kans en die nodige ondersteuning, sukses kan behaal – ŉ bevestiging dat ons Sterker Tesame is.
tgt: Isinqumo esiphusile esathathwa ngumqeqeshi wangaleso sikhathi u-Rassie Erasmus nethimba lakhe siyaqhubeka ukubonisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika nomhlaba wonke, ukuthi wonke umuntu onekhono, uma enikezwa ithuba nokwesekwa, angenza ezibukwayo – okuyisiqinisekiso sokuthi Sinamandla uma Sibambisene.

src: Allerbelangrik is hoedat die Springbokke se veerkragtigheid en vasberadenheid op die veld ŉ vergestalting is van dit wat aan die kern van Suid-Afrikanerskap lê, dit wat hierdie grootse nasie bo sy uitdagings laat uitstyg om telkens as oorwinnaar uit die stryd te tree.
tgt: Okubaluleke kakhulu, ukuphikelela nokuzimisela kwama-Springboks enkundleni yezemidlalo kubonise ukufana nse nokuba ngumuntu waseNingizimu Afrika, lokho okwenza lesi sizwe esikhulukazi sibhekane nazo zonke izingqinamba kanye nobunzima ukuze sizonqoba.

src: ŉ Paar van die uitblinkers in hierdie Springbokspan moes persoonlike struikelblokke oorkom onderweg na sukses.
tgt: Abanye babadlali abaphuma phambili eqenjini lama-Springboks bebebhekene nobunzima ezimpilweni zabo endleleni yabo eya ekunqobeni.

src: Die Kabinet se gelukwensings gaan aan Siyamthanda “Siya” Kolisi, die Springbokke se dubbele Wêreldbeker-wennerkaptein, met sy aanvoering van die span tot die Grootste van Alle Tye — en die vieringe duur steeds voort.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisele uSiyamtanda “Siya” Kolisi, ongukaputeni wama-Springboks onqobe kabili iNdebe Yomhlaba ngokuhola iqembu lafinyelela ezingeni esilibiza nge-Greatest of All Time (GOAT) kanti imigubho kufanele iqhubeke.

src: AGOA Forum Die Kabinet verwelkom die bevestiging deur beide die Amerikaanse administrasie sowel as die kongres dat hulle voornemens is om AGOA te verleng, wat sekerheid bring aan die beleggingsgemeenskap in die lande wat vir AGOA kwalifiseer.
tgt: IForamu ye-AGOA IKhabhinethi lamukele isiqinisekiso esenziwe ubuholi baseMelika kanye nenhlangano ngezinhloso zokwelula i-AGOA, nokuqinisekisa abatshalizimali emazweni afanelekile e-AGOIKhabhinethi liphinde lamukela ukusingathwa kweForamu ye-AGOA yezi-2023 eGoli kusuka mhla wesi-2 kuya mhla wesi-4 kuLwezi 2023 ebe nezethameli ezisuka emazweni ase-Afrika angama-32, umkhakha wezamabhizinisi, umphakathi kanye nomkhakha wezabasebenzi okokuqala ngqa kanye nabamele uhulumeni waseMelika.

src: Die Kabinet verwelkom ook die aanbieding van die 2023 AGOA Forum in Johannesburg vanaf 2–4 November 2023, wat bygewoon is deur deelnemers uit 32 Afrika-lande vanuit die geledere van regeringslui, die besigheidswêreld, die burgerlike samelewing en — die eerste keer ooit — georganiseerde arbeid, asook verteenwoordigers van die regering van die Verenigde State.
tgt: IKhabhinethi belihlezi njalo liqinisekisa ukuthi i-AGOA ihlinzeka ngethuba lokuthi iMelika iqinise ubudlelwano bayo bezomnotho ne-Afrika ngakho-ke kufanele yelulwe isikhathi esibonakalayo, iphinde yenziwe ngcono ibe negalelo futhi ihehe.

src: Die Kabinet meen steeds dat AGOA ŉ geleentheid bied vir die Verenigde State van Amerika om sy ekonomiese verhouding met Afrika te versterk en dus vir ŉ betekenisvolle tydperk verleng en aangevul moet word sodat dit ŉ groter impak kan hê en aantrekliker vir deelnemers kan wees.
tgt: UMhlangano woNgqongqoshe Bezokuvakasha be-BRICIKhabhinethi lamukele ukuphothulwa ngempumelelo koMhlangano woNgqongqoshe be-BRICS wangowezi-2023 obubanjwe eKapa, nalapho amazwe angamalungu ezinikele ekusebenzeni ngokubambisana kanye nokugqugquzela ezokuvakasha ngaphakathi kumazwe angamalungu e-BRICS, ukusungula imigudu ezohambeka kalula kwezokuvakasha kanye nokuxhumana phakathi kwamazwe angamalungu.

src: Dit sal ŉ verdere hupstoot gee aan Suid-Afrika se toerismesektor, wat reeds tekens van herstel toon.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqhubeka kuqinise umkhakha wezokuvakasha eNingizimu Afrika nosuvele ubonisa izimpawu zokuvuka.

src: Die land het 5,5 miljoen aankomste in die eerste agt maande van 2023 gehad, wat ŉ toename van 63,4% is, gemeet aan dieselfde tydperk in 2022.
tgt: Ezinyangeni eziyisishiyagalombili zokuqala kowezi-2023, izwe lamukela izivakashi ezingenayo eziyizigidi eziyisi-5.5 nokuchaza ukuthi izinga lezivakashi lenyuke ngama-63.4% kusuka esikhathini esifanayo ngowezi-2022.

src: Kieserregistrasie Die OVK het 18 en 19 November 2023 as die eerste kieserregistrasienaweek vir 2024 se algemene verkiesing aangekondig.
tgt: Ukubhalisela Ukuvota I-IEC imemezele ukuthi umhla we-18 nomhla we-19 kuLwezi 2023 kuzoba impelasonto yokuqala yokubhalisela ukuvota kuKhetho Lukazwelonke ngowezi-2024.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op alle stemgeregtigde kiesers om te registreer om in 2024 se algemene verkiesing by hul naaste stemlokaal te stem.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela bonke abantu abafaneleke ukuvota ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota kuKhetho Lukazwelonke ngowezi-2024 eziteshini zokuvota eziseduzane nabo.

src: Aanlyn kieserregistrasie is sedert Februarie 2023 beskikbaar, en burgers word versoek om die fasiliteit te gebruik om te registreer of hul besonderhede by te werk.
tgt: Ukubhalisela ukuvota ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-inthanethi selokhu kwavulwa kusukela ngoNhlolanja wezi-2023 kanti izakhamuzi ziyanxuswa ukuba zisebenzise le ndlela ukubhalisa noma ukushintsha imininingwane yabo.

src: Suid-Afrikaners wat vir hul ID's aansoek gedoen het, word aangemoedig om hul plaaslike kantoor van Binnelandse Sake te besoek om dit af te haal.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abafaka izicelo zomazisi babo bayagqugquzelwa ukuthi bavakashele ihhovisi loMnyango Wezasekhaya beyobalanda.

src: Daar is nog meer as 500 000 slim ID-kaarte wat by kantore van Binnelandse Sake regoor die land afgehaal moet word.
tgt: Kunamakhadi omazisi abangaphezu kwezi-50 000 abangalandiwe emahhovisi oMnyango Wezasekhaya kulolonke izwe.

src: Elektrisiteit Die Minister in die Presidensie getaak met elektrisiteit het omvattende inligting oor die land se elektrisiteitsituasie verskaf.
tgt: Ugesi UNgqongqoshe Kagesi eHhovisi likaMengameli usekhiphe umbiko ngesimo sikagesi kuleli lizwe.

src: Die Kabinet loof pogings deur die Gautengse provinsiale regering in samewerking met Eskom om elektrisiteittoevoer te herstel na gebiede in Gauteng wat deur stroomonderbrekings weens diefstal of skade aan transformators getref is.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayele ihlombe imizamo kaHulumeni Wesifundazwe sase-Gauteng osebenzisana no-Eskom ukubuyisa ugesi ezindaweni zase-Gauteng ebezilokhu zacinyelwa ugesi ngenxa yokwebiwa kanye nokucekelwa phansi kwama-transformer.

src: Gisteraand is ses nuwe elektriese transformators in Kagiso aan die Wes-Rand aangeskakel nadat gemeenskappe meer as drie jaar lank sonder krag was.
tgt: Izolo ebusuku, ama-transformer amasha ayisithupha aqale ukusebenza eKagiso, e-West Rand emva kokuthi umphakathi ubuhleli ngomnyama isikhathi esingaphezu kweminyaka emithathu.

src: Die Kabinet doen ŉ beroep op hierdie gemeenskappe om hierdie kritieke infrastruktuur teen diefstal, vandalisme en skade as gevolg van onwettige verbindings te beskerm.
tgt: IKhabhinethi licela le miphakathi ukuthi ivikele ingqalasizinda ebalulekile ukuthi ingebiwa, ingacekelwa phansi futhi ingalinyazwa ngenxa yokuxhuma ugesi ngokungemthetho.

src: Voedselvergiftiging Die Kabinet neem met kommer kennis van die vlaag voedselvergiftiging onder kinders as gevolg van die inname van verouderde en besmette voedsel afkomstig van spazawinkels en straatsmouse.
tgt: IKhabhinethi likhathazekile ngezehlakalo zokutholakala kwezingane ezidle ukudla okunobuthi osekudlulelwe yisikhathi nokunamagciwane ezikuthenga ezitolo eziyiziphaza nakulaba abadayisa emgwaqeni.

src: Dit is gerusstellend om te verneem van wetstoepassingspogings om voldoening aan voedselveiligheid af te dwing.
tgt: IKhabhinethi liyagqugquzeleka ngemizamo yabomthetho yokuqinisekisa ukuthi imithetho yokuphepha kokudla iyalandelwa.

src: Werkwinkel met burgemeesters en tradisionele leiers oor internasionale migrasie Die Kabinet is ingelig oor ŉ internasionale migrasiewerkwinkel, aangebied deur die Departement van Binnelandse Sake met die deelname van die DSBD, COGTA, Meslike Nedersettings en tradisionele leiers en burgemeesters van metro- en distriksmunisipaliteite, wat toegespits was op die bekamping van die gevolge van onwettige immigrasie, insluitend die bedrywighede van spazawinkels.
tgt: UMhlangano Wezokufudukela Kwamanye Amazwe noSodolobha kanye Nabaholi Bendabuko.

src: Sleuteluitkomste sluit in die instelling van omnibusverordeninge om uitdagings aan te spreek wat verband hou met die afdwinging van besigheidsverordeninge deur munisipaliteite en tradisionele owerhede.
tgt: IKhabhinethi litshelwe kafushane ngomhlangano omayelana nokufudukela kwamanye amazwe obusingathwe nguMnyango Wezasekhaya ngokubambisana ne-DSBD, i-COGTA, uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu kanye nabaholi bendabuko nosodolobha bamadolobha nomasipala besifunda nobugxile ekunqandeni imiphumela emibi yokufudukela kuleli lizwe ngokungemthetho, kubandakanya nokusebenza kwezitolo eziyiziphaza.

src: Besighede, veral spazawinkels, sal onmiddellik gesamentlik deur die departemente van arbeid, gesondheid en kleinsake-ontwikkeling asook Binnelandse Sake se immigrasie-inspektoraatspanne geïnspekteer word om die nakoming van toepaslike wette af te dwing.
tgt: Imiphumela ebalulekile ibandakanya ukwethulwa kwemithetho kamasipala ezobhekana nezinselele ezihlobene nokuthi umasipala neziphathimandla zendabuko ziqinisekisa kanjani ukuthotshelwa kwemithetho kamasipala yebhizinisi.

src: ŉ Oudit van spazawinkels in dorpies en townships sal onderneem word, en meganismes sal ingestel word om hulle deur beide tradisionele leiers en munisipaliteite te registreer.
tgt: Kuzoba nokuhlolisiswa okudidiyelwe kwamabhizinisi, ikakhulukazi iziphaza okuzokwenziwa uMnyango Wezabasebenzi, Owezempilo, Owokuthuthukiswa Kwamabhizinisi Amancane kanye namathimba abahloli boMnyango Wezasekhaya, ukuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwemithetho efanele.

src: Daar word ook gepoog om tradisionele owerhede te ondersteun om rekord te hou van buitelandse burgers in hul gemeenskappe.
tgt: Ukucwaningwa kweziphaza emakhaya nasemalokishini, kanye nezindlela zokuthi zibhaliswe ngaphansi kwabaholi bendabuko kanye nomasipala zizoqaliswa.

src: Besigheidslisensiewetgewing word tans gewysig om al diegene te ondersteun wat in die informele sektor wil handel dryf.
tgt: Kuneminye imizamo yokweseka iziphathimandla zendabuko ukuthi zikwazi ukugcina amabhuku anohlu lwabantu bokufika emiphakathini yabo.

src: Geïntegreerde misdaadbestryding Die Kabinet wens die SAPD geluk met die enorme slag wat hulle aan internasionale dwelmsindikate toegedien het nadat daar op 20 Oktober 2023 by ŉ pakhuis by Dube Handelshawe te King Shaka Internasionale Lughawe op kokaïen ter waarde van R80 miljoen beslag gelê is.
tgt: Indlela Edidiyelwe Yokulwa Nobugebengu IKhabhinethi lincome i-SAPS ngokuhlakaza amaqembu ashushumbisa izidakamizwa kwamanye amazwe kulandela ukuvunjululwa kwezidakamizwa zohlobo lwe-cocaine zenani lezigidi ezingama-R80 ezishaqwe mhla wama-20 kuMfumfu 2023 endaweni yokugcina impahla e-Dube Trade Port ngaphakathi e-King Shaka International Airport.

src: Twee dae voor die beslaglegging is daar ook op ŉ verdere R70 miljoen se kokaïen in ŉ houer by die Durbanse hawe beslag gelê.
tgt: Ezinsukwini ezimbili ngaphambi kokushaqwa kwezidakamizwa, enye i-cocaine yenani lezigidi ezingama-R70 yashaqwa kwisiqukathi esiseChwebeni laseThekwini.

src: Die Kabinet loof die SAPD vir hul ontwrigting en aftakeling van oorgrens georganiseerde misdaad, wat ŉ wesenlike bedreiging vir ons gemeenskappe en nasie inhou.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lishayela ihlombe i-SAPS ngomsebenzi wabo wokuphazamisa nokuhlakaza ubugebengu obuhleliwe obubeka imiphakathi nesizwe sakithi engozini.
